strings.en: The Mighty Walker has arrived!
Let's go, Soul Saber!
I've got the power to protect people!/　No way I'm not using it!
As this thing's pilot, I won't run!
I'll show you the power of Soul Saber!
I'll make up for my lack of experience/　with sheer spirit!
Let's do this, Soul Saber!
That's FF range!
Target locked!
Keep an eye on your surroundings too!
Let's go, Akemi!
Roger!
Be careful, Akimi!
I know!
Akimi, don't charge in carelessly!
They're still in our range, right?!
Right!
The target's pulling away!
Like I'd let you!
If you think it just got wings,/　you're dead wrong!
Feast your eyes! This is Super Soul Saber!
I'm counting on you, Super Soul Saber!
Super Soul Saber should be able to reach!
Back me up, you two!
All systems normal. We're good to go!
Enemy unit ahead!
It's in range!
All right, let's hit 'em!
I've got my footing back...!
Watch this. Payback time!
We can counterattack, Akimi!
Roger! Here I go!
Leave the Siebe Drive tuning to me.
Counting on you, Fairy!
Don't put too much faith in the Siebe Drive.
Right! Here I go!
Bring it on, Compatible Kaiser!
They're not going to go easy on us!
That's just how I want it!
Even against a commander unit, Soul Saber can...!
This won't be an easy fight, Akimi!
Golaikunru's lady mercenary.../　She's a tough one to fight.
A Golaikunru big shot/　showing up in a place like this...!
Here I come, Jua-Mu!
You'll have to deal with us too, Jua-Mu!
He's picked up steam in a weird direction...!
Jua-Mu!/　Super Soul Saber will be your opponent!
Al-Van, no tricks! Here I come!
The Raftclans has noticed us!
I know! We're going straight in!
We have to help Touya and the others!
Can we get close to the green Raftclans?!
Even Fu-Ruu has to have an opening!
Karo-Ran! I'll fight you fair and square!
That's the guy who killed Touya's dad...!
Gu-Landon! I won't let you overthrow anyone!
The Fury have more than one future!
And Touya and the others are the proof!
What an incredible opponent...!
No wonder Gu-Landon's so confident...!
Even so, we can't back down!
Whatever your goal is, if you come at us...!
If you don't want to get hurt, stay back!
I'm forcing my way through! Out of my way!
Sorry, Fairy./　Looks like we can't avoid a fight...!
Yes... I understand.
What the hell are you guys hiding?!
Vort! What is Herluga hiding?!
To take on the Gyanonia Ogre/　in this situation...!
Vort, tell me what you know!
Super Soul Saber as it is now/　can stand up to the Gyanonia Ogre!
Vort, stand down!/　Herluga is the one we have to fight!
Get out of the way, Reggiane!
The red Gyanonia... I'll break through it!
Herluga! I'm not letting you go anywhere!
Herluga... I can't entrust/　Gadisword's future to you!
Let's settle this here, Fairy!
I don't want to rely too much on the/　Cross Gate's power, but...!
Now's not the time to be picky!
I'll crush Herluga's ambitions here!
Is he one of Dark Brain's remnants too...?!
No way I'm losing to a clown like you!
You're getting more than a gut punch,/　Debudedabide!
I'll turn you into a mummy, Debudedabide!
I can't hit the cockpit...!
I need to be careful not to get too close...!
Just like that time... We can do it again now!
Damn Madnet, I'll shoot you down!
If no one's aboard!
Dragon or whatever, I'll take you on!
Here I come, Crystal Dragoon!
Your rampage ends here, Crystal Dragoon!
This thing's tough! No way I'm losing/　to some bag of bones!
I'll lay you to rest, Skull Knight!
Skull Knight!/　I'll hit you faster than you can move!
So that's another disaster the Cross Gate/　brought on us. But I'm not about to/　just accept it!
XN-L! We'll stop you right here!
We absolutely have to beat XN-L...!
Yes, that thing is a catastrophe/　for all intelligent life...!
We'll stop it right here!
We've already got data on Zovorg units!
I won't give you a chance to gather data!
How many times do you have to invade Earth/　before you're satisfied?!
Get off our planet!
Golaikunru, I won't let you do as you please!
Anyway, we have to save those two units...!
So this is a new Zovorg model, right...?!
Its weapons don't really seem/　Zovorg-like, though...!
Don't you move, Thick Cylinder!
There you are, Thick Cylinder!
Here it comes, Big Shoulder!
Big Shoulder, huh! Here I go!
Here I come, White Horn!
True to its name, that horn sure stands out!
No way I'm getting cold feet over Thorn!
We have to get through this no matter what...!
Here it comes, Cupid!
Don't you move, Cupid!
A Gasbra! Here I come!
I'll take that Gasbra!
Mass-produced Leonysis, huh!
Mass-produced Gyanonia, huh! Here I go!
With this Super Soul Saber,/　I'll stop you for sure!
Gadisword's new model... You won't get/　any further!
We'll protect Shinjuku!
Lamaris, just disappear already!
Guess we'll just have to take 'em out/　one by one!
I'll take them down before they multiply!
Looks like touching it wrong would get us cursed.
So please don't let that happen!
They can combine?!
I'll wipe you out, Lamaris Kaana!
Kaana type or not, I'll take you on!
Just because you got bigger,/　don't think you can beat a Mighty Walker!
You've gotten even more monstrous!
With Super Soul Saber,/　even Lamaris Ida is no match!
No matter how you look at it,/　that thing's a monster...!
I'll do my part for Arieil!
We have to get that thing off the Cross Gate!
Sitting quietly isn't my style!
Now it's my turn!
You're not getting away!
That was a half-hearted attack!
Time for a fresh start!
Time to strike back!
Now to turn the tide!
Let me pay you back!
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
Damn it! It's no good!!
I can't let a precious prototype/　get totaled!
S-Soul Saber's at its best in a pinch!
Ugh! What a pathetic fight I'm putting up!
I'm not letting go of these controls...!
Ngh, nasty creaking from all over...!
Our center of gravity's wobbling?!/　Did the balancer get hit?!
Uh-oh, the left monitor!
Can we limp along somehow...?!
Ugh... It's nothing but warning lights...!
A-Are we done for...?!!
This is where we hang tough, Akemi!
Right! We can't give up!
Akemi, it should still move somehow, right?!
Only just barely, though...
Don't give up! We still have options!
C-Can we even recover from this?!
Fairy and I will manage somehow!
So hang in there!
If I lose here, I don't even want to know/　what Dad and Jinpu will say...!
Jua-Mu...!/　I won't lose a battle of wills!
I'll stand up to Al-Van...!
Even Fu-Ruu has to have an opening somewhere...!
Karo-Ran, we're still alive...!
Gu-Landon!/　We can still fight, and so can Touya!
This isn't over yet, Iradoya!
Damn you, Gomoudokka!
If we're gonna stop Herluga,/　we have to take him down here...!
Vort...!/　I can't stop here...!
Watch this. I'm turning it around!
Vort... You'd really...!
It's not over yet! I won't give up!!
Y-You probably meant to wipe us out/　with that, but...
Here we still are...!
It's not over yet, Herluga!
I'm not gonna let this end/　with you laughing at us...!
I-I'm part of the Steel Dragons too...!/　I'll fight my way through any opponent...!
If I stay in the line of fire,/　I'll get shot down...!
Ugh! Fighting normally,/　I can't beat Thorn...!
How did everyone fight that guy before...?!
Crap, Jinpu's gonna chew me out for this!
I can't let the Mogami name/　get tarnished!
As long as the legs are fine, we can manage!
You got me good, damn it!
Ngh! We're tilting left?!/　Did the balancer get hit?!
Damn it, the hip motors are creaking!
Now Soul Saber shows what it can really do!
You think you can just push us over?/　Not happening!
Damn it, I took that head-on!
I'm purging the damaged armor!
They're starting to take control of the pace...!
No, they're not getting any further!
Leave the damage control to us!
Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Damn it, even with better mobility than before!
We'll handle damage control on our end!
Akimi, just focus on piloting!
Roger!
Akimi, we can still make up for it!
Getting beaten up won't look good, anyway!
Akimi, start your evasive maneuvers/　0.8 seconds sooner!/　I'll give you a signal too!
Got it!
Compatible Kaiser's tough, all right!
Ngh! Jua-Mu got me good...!
I need to read Al-Van's movements...!
I wasn't taking a Fury knight lightly,/　but...!
I took your hit, Karo-Ran!
If you want to call yourself Emperor,/　beat us first!
Damn you, Iradoya!
I'll show you what an Earth/　super robot can really do...!
Reggiane's Gyanonia.../　How do we break through?!
Ngh, Vort!
I won't let you get any further!
That guy's hitting every opening we leave!
He's one of Anex's top pilots, after all...!
Don't get cocky, Herluga!
I won't hand the Cross Gate over to you...!
What's with that thing's attacks?!
I took your hit, Crystal Dragoon!
Ngh, heavy hits for a skeleton...!
Deity ship or whatever, I won't flinch!
And we even have data on them!
I've drawn them in enough! Now...!
Can't believe I got hit by a battleship's guns!
Can't let my guard down with high-end models...!
Damn it! I won't let Thorn have its way!
Damn it, while I was struggling with Cupid...!
I can't believe a Gasbra did this much...!
It should be slower than Sally's Leonysis...!
I can't afford to struggle with Lamaris!
I can't get pushed back by a Kaana type!
Damn it, it didn't just get bigger...!
I should've been able to dodge that!
Crap, I focused too much on attacking!
Toughness is one of Soul Saber's strengths too!
Ngh, I don't think I'm flying on autopilot,/　but...!
Aw, man, the paint got scraped off!
Not bad aim, but that part's tough!
You think that'll stop Soul Saber?!
Don't underestimate Mogami's Mighty Walker!
Sorry, it hit us!
Dodge properly next time!
This much is fine, Akimi!
Thanks to this thing's armor!
Akimi, watch the enemy's movements!
Right, I'll dodge the next one!
So you can keep up with Super Soul Saber!
Doesn't look like much damage.
My check shows the same.
Still, we can't take many more hits like that!
Got my guard up just in time!
That kept the damage to a minimum.
I'm sorry, if only I'd backed you up...!
No, that was my mistake!
That didn't hurt, Kota!
Like I'd scream over something like this!
That didn't hurt, Jua-Mu!
That Raftclans is fast, all right!
This thing's not flimsy enough/　for you to tear apart!
Like that's gonna make me despair!
Damn Iradoya, landing every hit!
Quit meddling like this has nothing to do/　with you!
I managed to avoid a direct hit, but...!
Against him, that's plenty!
Akimi, put a little more distance/　between us and him!
Yeah, looks like that'd be smart...!
I won't let you stall for time, Reggiane!
And our output's way up too!
Floraga's attack range is way too wide...!
But there has to be an opening somewhere!
Debudedabide! That won't faze me!
I won't lose a contest of strength,/　Crystal Dragoon!
Ngh! That Skull Knight's fast!
That didn't hurt, XN-L!
No way I'm losing to a monster!
Like I'd lose to the Lamaris!
A Mighty Walker doesn't lose to monsters!
It's stronger than a Lamaris Kaana,/　but that's nothing!
Like I'd lose to a Zovorg machine!
That's it, come after me!
The Zovorg's prized weapons aren't/　so great after all!
Ngh! That Thorn's fast!
I can't believe a Cupid hit me...!
That Gasbra's fast!
You're weaker than Sally's Leonysis!
Being a super robot doesn't mean/　all I do is take hits!
Heh, way off target.
This thing can move quick!
Like that's gonna hit me!
Don't underestimate Soul Saber's mobility!
FF stands for Fighter First, you know!
That's how it's done!
The next one's coming right away,/　so eyes front!
They didn't call it Super for nothing!
Combining with the Saber Booster/　boosted my mobility!
Stuff like that won't hit/　Super Soul Saber!
Don't let your guard down, here comes another!
I dodged it, Kota!
All you've got is a big mouth, Jua-Mu!
Go fix that twisted attitude of yours!
Too slow, Karo-Ran!
He's not as fast as the Raftclans!
You'd better not be messing with us/　just for fun!
Remember the Mogami name, Gomoudokka!
I can't lose on Super Soul Saber's/　first sortie!
Don't take Vort's attacks head-on.
Yeah, I know!
Reggiane! We're racing the clock too!
We have to stop Herluga, fast!
We've got a Siebe Drive too,/　so we can do this!
I won't let you control Soul Saber!
This isn't the place for your magic tricks!
You can't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
What are you, Don Quixote?!
What were you aiming at, XN-L?!
I can take on Zovorg machines too!
I'll dodge even Thorn's attacks!
I knew I was in the Raftclans's range!
Like a Cupid could take me down!
Don't think a Gasbra can beat me!
You're slower than Sally's Leonysis!
Too slow, Lamaris Ida!
I didn't dodge that on a hunch, you know!
I'm not letting this thing get scratched/　for nothing.
Nice one, Akimi!
Yeah, I'll dodge the next one too!
The throttle response is way better than before!
Thanks for the assist, you two!
It's too early to relax!
Let's get ready for the next one!
We actually dodged Al-Van's attack...!
Just like you read it, Fairy!
I know a little about Vort's habits.
Let's keep this up!
Too bad!
It's what you call a barrier!
That won't work on me!
I won't fall for that!
Too bad.
That weapon won't work on me!
Damn it, I can't do anything!
And now's my chance to counterattack...!
Tch, out of ammo!
Ngh, I lost sight of it!
The FF loadout can't handle this...!
They've read our range!
Now it's our turn!
We can attack too!
I've gotta prove the Mighty Walker/　is worth something!
Soul Saber has arrived!
Super Soul Saber has arrived!
Leave this to me, Kota!
I'll help, Shoko!
Major Kai, I'll support you!
I'm going too, Lieutenant Lamia!
Right behind you, Lieutenant Hugo!
Covering you, Lieutenant Aqua!
I'll follow your lead, Arado!
After Seolla, it's my turn!
So you predicted I'd come in as backup.
Radha, leave this to me!
Major Gilliam, I'll cover you!
I can learn a lot from how that guy fights!
I'll follow Lieutenant Ryusei!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
I'll help, Touya!
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll support you!
Sieg, we'll take it from here!
Sieg cut in perfectly...!
Sally, leave the rest to me!
Sally made an opening for us!
The Mighty Walker is tough, after all!
I'll protect you with Soul Saber!
A Mighty Walker can take it!
Hold out for me, Super Soul Saber!
Kota, look out!
Shoko, I've got this!
Touya, fall back!
Get away, Touya!
Lieutenant Calvina, look out!
Sieg, I'll take this one!
You're being targeted, Sieg!
No need to worry, Sally!
Sally, I'll take this!
I'll hit you all at once!
I'll slam you one more time!
If you think it's over, you're dead wrong!
This seals it!
Take this!
There!
Go down!
Hit!
Hyaah!
Get blown away!
Drill Hard Punch!!
Take this!
Not done yet!
Oryaah!!
Hraaah!
Hyaah!
Break through!!
Come on, hit!
Drill Craft Missile!!
Go punch through!
I'll punch right through your armor!
Don't underestimate the FF loadout's power!
Drill, start spinning!
Spiral!
Tornaaado!
Twin Drill!
Raaaaagh!!
Spiral Tornaaado!!
Blast Sword, standby!
Boost on!
Limiter, release!
Full power!
Blade Burning!
Flare, expand!
Maximum!
Buuurn!!
This is our ace in the hole!
Now, brace yourself!
Limiter, off!
Go for it, Akimi!
Take thiiis!!
Blast Sword!!
Burn to ashes!!
Twin Long Cannon, active!
Target locked on!
Fire!!
Raising the barrels!
For long range, nothing beats this!
I can still keep going!
Eat this!!
This seals it!
Pierce!!
Charging in!
Assault!
Twin Drill! Spiiin!
Take this! Special attack! Spiral!!
Typhooooon!!
Take this!
Twin Drill! Spin to the limit!
Special attack! Spiral Typhoon!!
Attaaaaack!!
Blast!
Sword!!
Plasma Flaaare!!
Go!
Burrrrn!!
There!!
Blaze Field!
Full power!
Super Soul Saber!!
Raaaaaah!!
Hyper! Blast Swooooooord!!
Be swallowed by a tornado of flame!!
Our!
Ultimate special attaaack!!
Plasma Flare, maximum!
Special attack!/　Hyper Blast! Swoooooord!!
